title: thymus longicaulis subsp. moesiacus
intro: Thymus longicaulis subsp. moesiacus, commonly known as Moesian thyme, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This herb is valued for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which can help to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Moesian thyme include its ability to act as a natural expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and congestion, and its anti-anxiety and anti-depressive effects, promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents of Moesian thyme include essential oils such as thymol, carvacrol, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
